decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed use of the Old Vicarage as an independent primary school would generate additional traffic on the public highway, in this residential area, and would thus create conditions on the public highway detrimental to pedestrian safety, contrary to policies T 1.2 and T 2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan 
2.	Noise and disturbance from the increased activity on the site, and to and from the site, would result in a loss of amenity to the surrounding area, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, C 2.1 and H 3.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 
3.	It is considered that the design and scale of the external fire escape would detract from the character and appearance of the detached building, which is clearly visible in a prominent location fronting the A4, contrary to policy ENV-B 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan
description: Change of use from residential to an independent primary school for 75 pupils from 6-11 years of age in conjunction with the existing Heathfield House Day Nursery and School. Erection of an external fire escape staircase and alterations to dormer windows.
